reasons.action: The request explicitly asks to animate the photo and bring it to life with slow drifting motion, so the requested motion/behavior governs over the static poses in the reference sheet.
reasons.medium: The request does not ask for a different rendering medium or style; it only asks for animation, so the reference medium governs.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested, so the observed reference wardrobe governs.
reasons.lighting: No lighting source, direction, quality or replacement is requested, so the reference lighting governs.
reasons.framing: No actual camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or camera movement is requested; 16:9 is only a canvas ratio, so the actual-frame reference framing governs.
reasons.palette: No explicit color grade, saturation, contrast or tonal treatment is requested, so the reference palette governs.
